candidates.title: Rough Wood
candidates.creator: Rob Tuytel
candidates.inspection_result: Diffuse, OpenGL normal, and roughness maps were inspected in the permanent frame. Three single-board regions were cropped to exclude photographed joints, oriented along each member, and rendered with non-colour normal/roughness handling.

project_derivatives.source: Project-original registered rear-world edits made with OpenAI's built-in image generation capability from accepted prior plates plus captured production frame guides; exact prompts retained in assets/source/generated/PROMPT.md
project_derivatives.transformation: The desktop plate reconstructs only the rear world visible through the captured live aperture, removes duplicate foreground structure, and leaves a blank attached wall for HTML photographs. The portrait plate is a deliberate same-world recomposition with the wall registered to the verified phone attachment region. Selected 1536 by 1024 and 1024 by 1536 PNG masters were inspected with the live frame and still-image AVIF-encoded with FFmpeg.

project_derivatives.source: Deterministic first-frame captures of the implemented timber shutter, rails, counter, right reveal wall, lighting, and retained CC0 apple over the new real-farm plate
project_derivatives.transformation: Captured from the permanent-frame local WebGL start state at 1536 by 1024 and 640 by 960 CSS pixels with HTML interface layers suppressed; still-image AVIF-encoded with FFmpeg at CRF 30. The real apple mesh rests on the permanent receiving counter and casts its calculated shadow. These are loading posters, not independent artwork or review baselines.

project_derivatives.source: Deterministic complete-state captures of the implemented permanent frame, real Hudson Graves farm photograph, timber reveal, lighting, and camera
project_derivatives.transformation: Captured at 1536 by 1024 and 640 by 960 CSS pixels with interface layers suppressed; still-image AVIF-encoded with FFmpeg at CRF 30. Used for reduced motion, scene failure, and complete-session loading so the aperture never becomes empty or structurally mismatched.

project_derivatives.source: Rob Tuytel's CC0 Rough Wood diffuse, OpenGL normal, and roughness maps from Poly Haven
project_derivatives.transformation: Three source regions containing uninterrupted single-board grain were cropped from each map, scaled to 1024 by 128 for horizontal members, and transposed/scaled to 128 by 1024 for vertical members. Diffuse maps use sRGB; normal and roughness remain non-colour.
